_doc: Ranked prebuild targets for `hctf prebuild --lane binary`: HCFG storage encodings NOT yet in lib.binary.hcfg_scan (it already covers raw, base64/url, separated hex, base32/85/a85, UTF-16LE/BE, reversed, single-byte xor, zlib/gzip/deflate). Offsets of new encodings are speculative (first byte of the stored form).

targets.goal: HCFG body or whole blob XOR'd with a repeating 2-16 byte key (key stored next to it or in the header); known-plaintext 'HCFG' recovers it
base64 with a shuffled/custom alphabet stored as a 64-char string in the binary
base64 text further ROT13'd / case-swapped / reversed per line
blob split across several adjacent string literals or a table of short chunks (concatenate in file order / by index)
blob stored as an int/uint32/uint16 array in .data/.rodata (little/big endian) or as a decimal/char-code list '72,67,70,71'
RC4-encrypted HCFG with the key as a nearby printable string (try short printable strings within 4 KB as keys)
base64 (or hex) of zlib/gzip/lzma/bz2 of the blob; also lzma/bz2/xz streams raw in the file
byte transforms: nibble swap, bitwise NOT, add/sub constant, rotate-left bits, before or after base64
interleaved/strided bytes (every 2nd/4th byte, two halves interleaved) and wide-char variants beyond UTF-16
